Ordinary Council Meeting - Kununurra

Tuesday, September 30, 2025 - 05:00 PM

At the Ordinary Council Meeting 24 June 2025, Council resolved to move the date of this meeting from the originally scheduled date of the 23 September 2025 to 30 September 2025.

OFFICER’S RECOMMENDATION / COUNCIL DECISION

Minute Number: 24/06/2025 - 119215

Moved: Cr C McNeil

Seconded: Cr T Chafer

That Council:

  1. Amends the 2025 Ordinary Council Meeting schedule for the following meetings due to a conflict with the Developing Northern Australia Conference and the WALGA Local Government Convention:
    1. Reschedule the 22 July 2025 Ordinary Council Meeting to 29 July 2025.
    2. Reschedule the 23 September 2025 Ordinary Council Meeting to 30 September 2025.
  2. Requests the Chief Executive Officer to update all public notices, the Shire website, and relevant meeting calendars to reflect the revised meeting dates in accordance with the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996.

Carried: 9/0

For: Cr D Menzel, Cr T Chafer, Cr M Dear, Cr D Hearty, Cr B Kyne, Cr J Gooding, Cr C McNeil, Cr B Robinson, Cr S Timms

Against: Nil

Special Council Meeting - Kununurra

Tuesday, August 5, 2025 - 05:00 PM

In accordance with Section 5.4 (b) of the Local Government Act 1995, the Shire of Wyndham East Kimberley wishes to inform the public of a Special Council Meeting taking place on Tuesday 5 August 2025 at 5:00pm at the Kununurra Council Chambers.
The purpose of this meeting is to consider award of T22-24/25 Provision of Consultancy Services for Upgrade for Kununurra Leisure Centre (KLC) Stage 1.
The meeting is open to the public to attend.

Council Meetings

Meeting Information

Council and Committee meetings are scheduled in advance and held in accordance with the meeting dates adopted by Council, refer to the table below.

  • Meetings commence at 5.00pm, unless otherwise advised.
  • Council and Committee meetings are held at the Kununurra Council Chambers.
  • Wyndham Meet and Greets are held at the Wyndham Council Chambers.
  • Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers and may participate during Public Question Time in accordance with meeting procedures.
  • From time to time, parts of a meeting may be closed to the public where confidential matters are being considered, in accordance with legislative requirements.

Any change to the date or time of a Council meeting will be advertised on the Shire’s website, social media channels and public noticeboards.

Wyndham Meet and Greet

The Wyndham Meet and Greet is an informal, open forum for the Wyndham community to come together and discuss matters that affect the town and surrounding area. It provides residents with the opportunity to raise local issues, share ideas, and ask questions in a relaxed setting.

These sessions allow for open and constructive conversation with Councillors and the Shire’s Executive Management Team, helping to strengthen communication and understanding between Council and the community.

The Wyndham Meet and Greet is held at the Wyndham Council Chambers and runs for one hour, commencing at 5.00pm. Please refer to the table above for upcoming meeting dates.

Public question time

Public Question Time is held early in each Council meeting and provides members of the public with the opportunity to ask questions of Council about matters affecting the Shire.

This session is strictly for questions only. Statements, commentary, debate or preambles are not permitted.

All questions must be submitted in writing prior to the commencement of the meeting using the Public Question Time Form. The form requires your name and contact details and is available:

  • online,

  • from the Shire administration office, or

  • at the sign-in desk before the meeting.

Questions submitted in advance and relating directly to items on the meeting agenda will be given priority. Other questions will be addressed as time permits.

Each person may ask a maximum of two questions, with each question not exceeding 150 words and a speaking time limit of two minutes per question. Questions with multiple parts are considered separate questions.

When called upon, questioners are required to stand at the lectern at the front of the public gallery, state their name and locality, and read their question aloud.

Where a question cannot be answered at the meeting, it may be taken on notice. A written response will be provided at a later date and included in the agenda and minutes of the next Ordinary Council Meeting.

Once a response has been provided, the matter is considered concluded. Discussion or debate with Councillors or officers during Public Question Time is not permitted.

Conduct During Meetings

Council meetings are conducted in an orderly and respectful manner to allow Council business to be carried out efficiently and fairly.

Members of the public must not interrupt, disturb or disrupt the meeting, including through disorderly behaviour, interjections or actions that interfere with proceedings.

If a person’s behaviour is considered disruptive, the Presiding Officer may direct that person to leave the Council Chambers or the Shire building for the remainder of the meeting.

Live Streaming

Council meetings are live streamed to improve access and transparency for the community.

To watch the live stream of an upcoming meeting, please visit the Shire’s YouTube channel. The live stream will commence at the scheduled meeting start time. Where available, recordings of meetings will remain accessible on the channel after the meeting concludes.

Agendas

Agendas for each Council and Committee meeting are published on or before the Friday prior to the meeting, in accordance with legislative requirements. The agenda includes reports and information on all matters to be considered by Council or Committee members.

To view the agenda for an upcoming meeting, please scroll further down this page.

Agendas and minutes from previous Council and Committee meetings are available on the Past Meetings page.
